_label: Lord-I-Call sticheron at verse (1), Martyr Paramon and the 370 Martyrs (11-29)

commemoration.title: Martyr Paramon and 370 Martyrs in Bithynia

_note: Base row 10844 was split out of 9468 on 2026-11-25 (the scrape had run stichera 2 and 3 together, so a mis-keyed Acacius sticheron filled this slot). order 7 because orders 3-6 are the alternative set and its Stavrotheotokion. Parish sings the OCA engraved-music text.

_provenance.family_note: Identical to the stichera row it stands in for.

value.text: The honored choir of spiritual athletes, * three hundred seventy in number, * with faith cast down the delusion * of the polytheism of the all-iniquitous; * and with them thou also wast crowned, * having struggled with valiant mind, * O Paramon, * and, rejoicing, didst join * the choirs of the incorporeal ones. * With them do thou pray, * that we who honor and ever bless thee * may be delivered ** from all sorrow and perils.

value.text:
The honored choir of athletes,
three hundred seventy in number,
with faith cast down the falsehood of the evil-doers' idolatry.
You also were crowned with them,
having struggled with a courageous mind, O Paramon,
and rejoicing, you joined the choirs of the bodiless hosts!
Ever pray with them that we who honor and bless you//
may be delivered from all sorrow and dangers!
